lesson: The adaptive conditional-boundary method is confirmed on all 12 listed practice cases, including unchanged archived-predictor reuse on design_case_000 and revised predictors on the other 11. Fresh confirmation passed for design_case_011 at MSE 4.27e-20 on 96 rows; design_case_010 also passed at 3.62e-20 after adaptive refinement. Request publication of this method.
